intro.zh: 今天这批项目反映出一个清晰信号：AI 正从通用聊天界面下沉到具体工作流——股票分析、CAD 绘图、视频剪辑、3D 重建，都在把模型能力封装成可交付的成品。同时，本地优先、隐私可控的工具重新受到青睐，开源项目开始直接对标商业软件的核心场景。
intro.en: Today's projects show AI moving from general chat interfaces into concrete workflows: stock analysis, CAD drafting, video editing, and 3D reconstruction are packaging model capabilities into deliverable products.

zh.summary: 给已有 agent 增加可控记忆的开源项目，存储带来源的显式事实，支持更正和撤回，并让同一份记忆在多个 agent 间共享。它从无密钥的关键词检索起步，再按需叠加语义搜索和后台增强。
zh.insight: 记忆层的「可审计」是差异化点：每条事实都有出处、可更正。适合做面向团队的知识记忆服务，切合规敏感场景，比如客服或法务，和黑盒向量库相比更容易解释和追责。

en.summary: An open-source project that gives existing agents controllable memory: it stores explicit facts with sources, supports corrections and withdrawal,
en.insight: Auditable memory is the differentiator: every fact has a source and can be corrected. This suits a team knowledge-memory service for compliance-sensitive…

zh.summary: Google DeepMind 维护的通用物理引擎，专注多关节动力学与接触仿真，广泛用于机器人、生物力学和强化学习研究。它提供 C API 和桌面/浏览器可视化，是机器人学习领域的事实标准基础设施。
zh.insight: 适合作为机器人仿真或具身智能产品的底层引擎，而不是直接做应用。如果想切入，可以在 MuJoCo 之上做特定场景的仿真环境封装，比如仓储抓取或四足运动，降低非专家的使用门槛。

en.summary: A general-purpose physics engine maintained by Google DeepMind, focused on multi-joint dynamics and contact simulation for robotics, biomechanics, and reinforcement learning.
en.insight: Use it as the underlying engine for robotics or embodied-AI products rather than building an app directly.

items.description: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 本地桌面应用，一键把普通视频或图片序列转成 3D Gaussian Splatting，内置 FFmpeg、COLMAP 和 Brush，全程使用本机 CPU/GPU，素材无需上传云端。它把原本需要命令行拼接的重建流程封装成了选素材、选质量档、等结果。
zh.insight: 3D 重建的瓶颈正在从算法转向工作流。可以面向房产、文物、电商展示做「拍摄到可交互 3D 模型」的托管服务，用 OOOSplat 做本地预处理，云端只负责发布和嵌入，避开重计算成本。

en.summary: A local desktop app that turns ordinary or panoramic videos and image sequences into 3D Gaussian Splats in one click.
en.insight: The bottleneck in 3D reconstruction is shifting from algorithms to workflow. Offer a shoot-to-interactive-3D-model service for real estate, artifacts,

items.description: A local desktop app that turns videos and images into 3D Gaussian Splats in one click.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 基于 PyTorch 的说话人日志开源工具包，提供语音活动检测、说话人变化检测、重叠语音检测和说话人嵌入等预训练模型，支持微调。它是会议转写、播客处理等场景中「谁在什么时候说话」环节的常用底座。
zh.insight: 说话人日志是会议和客服录音分析的关键中间层。可以基于它做垂直的对话分析产品，比如销售通话的说话人分离加话术评估，重点在把 diarization 结果和业务指标对齐，而不是自己训模型。

en.summary: An open-source speaker diarization toolkit built on PyTorch, offering pretrained models for speech activity detection, speaker change detection, overlapped speech detection,
en.insight: Diarization is a key middle layer for meeting and support-call analysis. Build a vertical conversation analytics product on top of it,

items.description: Neural building blocks for speaker diarization: speech activity detection, speaker change detection, overlapped speech detection, speaker embedding
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: Anthropic 推出的终端内智能编码工具，理解代码库、执行常规任务、解释复杂代码并处理 git 工作流，全部通过自然语言完成。它把 AI 编程从 IDE 插件扩展到命令行和 CI 场景，是当前 agentic coding 的代表产品。
zh.insight: 对创业者来说，它更像一个信号：终端正在成为 AI 编程的主入口。机会不在复刻它，而在围绕它做配套——比如团队级的权限审计、成本看板、或针对特定技术栈的提示词与工作流模板。

en.summary: Anthropic's agentic coding tool that lives in the terminal, understands your codebase, executes routine tasks, explains complex code,
en.insight: For founders, it signals that the terminal is becoming the primary entry point for AI coding. The opportunity isn't cloning it but building around it:…

items.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.

zh.summary: 用 Rust 构建的开源 CAD 应用，支持 2D 绘图和 3D 建模，原生读写 DWG/DXF，桌面和浏览器共享同一编辑核心，并带 GPU 加速渲染。它试图打破 DWG 格式长期被商业软件锁定的局面。
zh.insight: DWG 原生读写是稀缺能力。机会不在做通用 CAD，而在垂直场景的轻量查看与批注，比如施工图纸会审或制造业来图报价，用浏览器端降低协作方安装门槛，按席位收费。

en.summary: An open-source CAD application built in Rust with 2D drafting and 3D modeling, native DWG/DXF read-write, a shared editing core across desktop and browser,
en.insight: Native DWG read-write is scarce. The opportunity isn't general CAD but vertical lightweight viewing and annotation,

items.description: A CAD application built with Rust — 2D/3D drawing, DWG/DXF support, and GPU-accelerated rendering

zh.summary: 开源的 CapCut 替代品，目标是用一套代码覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端的视频编辑。当前正在重写，规划包括插件架构、MCP 服务器、无头渲染和脚本标签页，方向是把视频编辑变成可编程的工作流。
zh.insight: 视频编辑的插件生态和自动化渲染是空白点。可以围绕 OpenCut 的插件 API 做垂直模板市场，比如电商商品视频或播客切片，让非剪辑师也能批量产出。注意它还在重写期，适合早期押注而非立即依赖。

en.summary: An open-source CapCut alternative aiming to cover web, desktop, and mobile video editing from one codebase. It is being rewritten with plans for a plugin architecture, MCP server,
en.insight: The plugin ecosystem and automated rendering are gaps. A vertical template marketplace built on OpenCut's plugin API,

zh.summary: 轻量级云原生 GIS 平台，可在浏览器、桌面、移动端和 Jupyter 中运行，内置 1000 多个基于 WebAssembly 的地理处理工具，覆盖地形、水文、LiDAR 和遥感分析，数据不离开本机。
zh.insight: 浏览器内完成专业 GIS 分析，意味着可以绕过传统桌面 GIS 的安装和授权。适合做面向规划、环保或农业的轻量分析工具，把特定工作流（如洪水淹没模拟）做成模板，按项目收费。

en.summary: A lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform that runs in browsers, on desktop, mobile, and inside Jupyter. It ships 1,000+ WebAssembly geoprocessing tools for terrain, hydrology,
en.insight: Professional GIS analysis in the browser bypasses the install and licensing of traditional desktop GIS.

items.description: A lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing, exploring, and analyzing geospatial data. It runs in the web browser, on the desktop, on mobile, and inside Jupyter notebooks.

zh.summary: 跨平台的网络流量监控桌面应用，用 Rust 编写，界面直观，支持 IP 地理定位和多种协议过滤。它把 tcpdump 级别的能力做成了普通用户能看懂的 GUI，适合排查异常连接和隐私自查。
zh.insight: 面向非安全专家的「网络体检」是个被低估的场景。可以在 Sniffnet 之上做家庭或小团队的异常流量告警，比如检测智能家居设备外联，用订阅制提供规则更新而非卖软件本身。

en.summary: A cross-platform network traffic monitor built in Rust with an intuitive GUI, IP geolocation, and protocol filtering.
en.insight: Network checkups for non-security experts are an underrated scenario. Build anomaly alerts for homes or small teams on top of Sniffnet,

zh.summary: 一个 LLM 驱动的多市场股票分析系统，自动聚合行情、新闻和基本面数据，生成决策仪表盘并推送到企业微信、飞书、Telegram 等渠道，支持零成本定时运行。它解决的是散户和轻量投资者没有时间盯盘、又想要结构化结论的问题。
zh.insight: 面向个人投资者做「每日决策简报」订阅，关键不在预测涨跌，而在把多源信息压缩成可执行的检查清单。和通用财经资讯 App 的差别是：它按你的自选股生成，而不是推送大众新闻。

en.summary: An LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system that aggregates quotes, news, and fundamentals, then generates a decision dashboard pushed to WeCom, Feishu, Telegram, and more.
en.insight: Build a daily decision-brief subscription for individual investors. The value isn't predicting prices but compressing multi-source information into an…

items.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.
